verdict.rationale: Unstructured exposes a REST API and Python SDK usable from standard scripts/cURL, plus job APIs to trigger, monitor, and download workflow runs — enabling headless/CI automation, and the runtime probe confirms the jobs API is live and auth-gated (suitable for CI keys). missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), no independent user reports of CI usage, and vendor docs now steer agents away from the open-source SDK/CLI toward the hosted platform, adding some ambiguity about the recommended headless path.
